title: The ceiling guard also reads CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION, and the docs call it a guard against carelessness, not a boundary
goal: bl_authority.in_agent_session reads CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION (set in every subprocess Claude Code starts) besides CLAUDECODE, so a session command that clears CLAUDECODE alone ('CLAUDECODE= python3 _tools/backlog.py answer ...' or 'env -u CLAUDECODE ...') is still refused for a ceiling-class gate and a tests-ceiling decision; backlog.md and tools.md say the environment check guards against a careless delegated session, not one set on defeating it; any deny rule in .claude/settings.json for commands that clear these variables is the operator's call, asked as a gate

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;sys.exit(0 if a.in_agent_session({'CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION':'1'}) else 1)
